ct.title: Chat with the shop
ct.entry: A question or a problem with this order? Message the shop directly.
ct.st.order: This chat is closed; the order is complete and messages are read-only.
ct.st.issue: If something is wrong, tap “I have a problem” by {d}; this same chat reopens.
ct.st.late: The time for “I have a problem” on this order has passed.
ct.st.idle: This chat closed after a few days without messages. For a new question, tap “New chat”.
ct.st.reopened: The chat is open again; describe the problem to the shop.
ct.st.blocked: This shop is not accepting your messages right now.
ct.empty: No messages yet. Write your question.
ct.queued: Not sent yet; it will go by itself when the internet is back.
ct.au.gone: This voice message is no longer on the server; it was deleted or has expired.
ct.au.codec: This browser cannot play this audio format.
ct.err: The chat did not open; try again.
ct.v.title: To chat with the shop, confirm your mobile number with a code.
err.issue_window_passed: The time for “I have a problem” on this order has passed.
err.chat_blocked: This shop is not accepting your messages right now.
